Film & Television

Crocs on set.
Crew safe.

Specialist animal wrangling and on-set safety for major international productions — trusted by the BBC, National Geographic and Animal Planet.

Get the shot. Keep everyone safe.

Our expertise extends well beyond crocodile and reptile management. Crocodile Safety Australia has provided professional animal wrangling and safety officer services for major international television and wildlife productions across Australia.

We’re an established, trusted partner for film, television, documentary and wildlife productions that need specialist animal handling, risk management and on-site safety expertise.

  • Professional animal wrangling — crocodiles, venomous snakes and native fauna
  • Dedicated safety officer services for cast and crew
  • Underwater animal wrangling and aquatic site safety
  • Risk assessment and SWMS for wildlife-involved productions
  • Liaison with relevant wildlife authorities and permit management
  • Remote and regional location support across Northern Australia
